chain_words.nuance: to be unlike something else in some respects
to hold a different opinion from someone
to come into conflict because of opposing values or views
to be in sustained opposition over fundamental matters
to come into forceful opposition as two cultures or systems meet

explanation: These words all describe cultures or values being in opposition, from a simple difference to a forceful collision.

usage_notes.difference: 'Clash' describes conflicting values or views in contact; 'collide' suggests a more forceful, head-on opposition between cultures or systems.
